prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified. THREE rows, TWO columns. TOP VERE adult woman, younger sister, dark brown hair loose braid, muted blue-grey plain wool dress, sturdy shoes; holds HER OWN folded worn plum robe with one small pale repaired inner seam, ordinary undecorated garment, not noble regalia; watchful dignified posture. MIDDLE DORO adult older sister, chestnut hair tied back with tan scarf, olive dress and weathered ochre apron, a small plain empty wooden bowl in both hands; tired upright caregiver. BOTTOM ZAHO adult woman returning weaver and independent shuttle innovator, short dark hair tied back, rust-red work tunic over charcoal skirt, leather belt pouch, one modest wooden weaving shuttle held herself. Sisters have separate belongings; no robe sale or identity disclosure. Shuttle shape is tentative, do not invent shared ancestry or a teacher.
